"''Not toxic. Not anymore. Just forbidden.|A [[The Smuggler|young smuggler]] and [[Tam Bastion]]|}} '''Anoat''' was a [[planet]] located in the [[Anoat system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. It was once a sprawling [[ecumenopolis|city-world]] that, as seat of the [[Nothoiin]] [[Noble Court]], was the [[capital]] of the [[Anoat sector]]. However, after being [[Gassing of Anoat|gassed]] by the [[Galactic Empire]], the planet was polluted and largely abandoned. ==Description== Anoat was connected to the planet [[Sullust]] by the [[Incisor Sidestep]] [[hyperspace route]] and the [[Ring of Kafrene]] [[mining]] colony by the [[Corellian Trade Spine]], which also continued on from Anoat out toward [[Wild Space]]. ==History== {{Quote|This wasn't an accident. This was the Empire's doing.''"
"''Come on. The Empire wouldn't—I mean, this was years before Alderaan and the Death Star…''"
"''Now you understand why our Rebellion keeps fighting.|Tam Bastion and a young smuggler|}} [[File:Anoat_City.png|thumb|left|250px|Anoat was a city-sprawled planet.]] Once a sprawling [[city]]-[[Planet|world]], Anoat served as the [[capital]] of the entire [[Anoat sector]]. However, [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]], [[Captain]] [[Ubrik Adelhard]] was sent to deal with a base of [[Anoat dissidents|dissidents]] on Anoat. He chose to have his forces [[Gassing of Anoat|gas]] the entire planet,[[Battle of Jakku — Insurgency Rising 1|''Battle of Jakku — Insurgency Rising'' 1]] and the [[atmosphere]] became toxic and [[poison]]ous, forcing much of the population to flee from the polluted world. Some people, however, did not leave the planet. Those who did not [[Death|die]] were driven insane by the toxins, evolving over time into savage and feral creatures referred to as "[[Lurker (Anoat)|Lurkers]]." During the [[Galactic Civil War]], the planet was under the control of the [[Galactic Empire]] and contained the sector's largest concentration of [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]]. The [[Resistance]] maintained a [[Resistance Camp|camp]] on Anoat during its [[First Order-Resistance War|fight]] against the [[First Order]], which could not detect the rebels with long-range sensors thanks to the pollution on the world. Sometime after the [[Battle of Crait]], General [[Jonato]] warned that a transmission from the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] world of [[Tah'Nuhna]] threatened to expose the Resistance presence on Anoat, but he was overruled by [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. {{Planet-stub}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Anoat}} *''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]'' {{Mo}} *{{StoryCite|story=The Rising|book=Battle of Jakku — Insurgency Rising 1}} {{Flash}} *''[[Star Wars: Uprising]]'' {{1st}} *[[Allegiance 1|''Allegiance'' 1]] *[[Allegiance 2|''Allegiance'' 2]] {{Co}} *[[Allegiance 3|''Allegiance'' 3]] ==Sources== *''[[The Art of Star Wars: Uprising]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|C-3PO}} *{{GalaxyMapPoster}} {{MapPoint}} *''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' {{MapPoint}} *''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian Visual Guide]]'' {{MapPoint}} *{{StarWarsGalaxyMap}} {{MapPoint}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Anoat |fr=Anoat |ja=アノート }} [[Category:Anoat system locations]] [[Category:Ecumenopolises]] [[Category:Galactic Empire planets]] [[Category:Jedi planets]] [[Category:Planets in the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Planets in the Western Reaches]] [[Category:Resistance planets]] [[Category:Sector capitals]] [[Category:Terrestrial planets]] {{RelatedCategories |[[Category:Anoat locations]] }}
